product.name: shellspec
product.eyebrow: Shell command IR · no release yet
promise: one IR and a category per command out.
product.lede: An agent's Bash tool sends a whole script in one string: cd x && cargo test 2>&1 | tail. shellspec lifts that string from bash, POSIX sh, zsh or fish into one IR of lists, pipelines, simple commands, redirects, heredocs and substitutions, and gives every simple command a category from a declared ruleset. Lifting is pure: nothing is executed, expanded or globbed.
product.description: A Rust library and CLI that lifts shell command strings from bash, sh, zsh and fish into one IR and classifies every simple command with a declared ruleset.

sections.title: From a string to a categorised list.
sections.lede: Each step is a function of the library and a command of the shellspec binary.

steps.label: lift
steps.title: Parse in a dialect
steps.description: lift(text, dialect) returns a Script; input that does not parse becomes Unk nodes with diagnostics, never an error.

steps.label: invocations
steps.title: Flatten and classify
steps.description: invocations(script, ruleset) lists every simple command with its wrappers, pipe stage, cwd and category.

steps.label: shape
steps.title: Redact
steps.description: shape(script) keeps node kinds, programs, subcommands and flag names, and drops the words.

sections.title: What the repository holds.
sections.lede: Specification first: every noun is declared in an ESS specification before code uses it.

items.title: IR
items.description: shell-ir/1, declared in spec/ and projected to JSON Schema in generated/.

items.title: Ruleset
items.description: YAML rules with a digest; rules check refuses ties and wrappers without arity.

items.title: Corpus
items.description: The counts the design rests on: operators, pipes, first words, parser refusals.
